r11.condition: Promotion remains blocked after an admission until its previously-green affected tests have green results under the radius-specific safeguard with ADMISSION_RADIUS_CAP = 40.
r11.falsifier: A radius of at most ADMISSION_RADIUS_CAP = 40 files lacks its complete pre-publication related-test check at the built unpublished admission commit, a red-adding within-cap admission publishes, or a refusal lacks the test and leg; an over-cap radius runs partially or lacks the admission's skipped-over-cap record; the next red repair round lacks attribution of each newly red previously-green test to its window admissions naming test, leg, admission and basis; the queue leaves awaiting-fixer before that test re-measures green.
r11.note: Proposed atomic statement with the complete within-cap and over-cap observable branches retained in its falsifier; requires outside-lineage semantic approval, not merely detector acceptance.
